source: Natural Earth 1:50m Cultural Vectors, Admin 0 - Countries (ne_50m_admin_0_countries), https://www.naturalearthdata.com/ via https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector
simplification: topology-preserving Douglas-Peucker, tolerance 0.01 deg (small island countries: 1:10m outline, tolerance 0.002 deg: VI, GU, AS, IO, PN, AI, BM, VG, TC, MS, JE, GG, IM, SG, SC, VC, LC, KN, NU, CK, AW, CW, NR, MU, MT, GD, PM, BL, DM, BB, BH, HM, NF, AG, TV), coordinates rounded to 3 decimals; polygons largest first; first ring of a polygon is the outline, further rings are holes; rings are open (the closing point is dropped)
encoding: bbox and view are [[south, west], [north, east]] in degrees. Each ring is a flat list of integers in 1/scale degree: lat, lng of the first point, then for every further point the difference to the previous one (dlat, dlng). Running sums divided by scale give the [lat, lng] points.
